lines.speaker: teacher
lines.en: Yunxi and Yue are very hungry.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.pinyin: Yuè, nǐ è ma? Wǒ hěn è!
lines.en: Yue, are you hungry? I'm starving!

lines.speaker: yueB
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě hěn è, yě hěn kě.
lines.en: I'm hungry too, and thirsty.

lines.speaker: teacher
lines.en: Yunxi and Yue come to a restaurant.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Qǐng gěi wǒmen càidān.
lines.en: Hello! Please give us the menu.

lines.speaker: teacher
lines.en: Sure. What would you like to drink?

lines.speaker: yueB
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yào rè chá. Yúnxī, nǐ ne?
lines.en: I'd like hot tea. Yunxi, and you?

lines.speaker: hero
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan kāfēi. Yǒu kāfēi ma?
lines.en: I like coffee. Do you have coffee?

lines.speaker: teacher
lines.pinyin: Méiyǒu kāfēi. Yǒu chá, yǒu niúnǎi.
lines.en: No coffee. There's tea, and there's milk.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.en: Then I'll have cold milk.

lines.speaker: yueB
lines.hanzi: 我们要鸡肉、米饭和两个菜。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen yào jīròu, mǐfàn hé liǎng gè cài.
lines.en: We'd like chicken, rice and two dishes.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.en: This chicken is delicious!

lines.speaker: yueB
lines.en: How much is it?

lines.speaker: teacher
lines.en: Fifty yuan.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.en: Not expensive! Thanks, bye!

questions.qEn: What does Yue want to drink?

lines.speaker: teacher
lines.en: Yunxi and Yue are in China.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.hanzi: 你好！我叫云希。你叫什么名字？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Wǒ jiào Yúnxī. Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?
lines.en: Hi! I'm Yunxi. What's your name?

lines.speaker: yueB
lines.en: I'm Yue.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.en: Are you Chinese?

lines.speaker: yueB
lines.pinyin: Bú shì. Wǒ lái Zhōngguó shuō Hànyǔ.
lines.en: No. I came to China to speak Chinese.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.en: Your Chinese is very good!

lines.speaker: yueB
lines.en: Thanks. What do you want to eat?

lines.speaker: hero
lines.en: I want to eat everything!

lines.speaker: yueB
lines.en: OK, see you tomorrow!

lines.speaker: hero
lines.en: Bye!

questions.qEn: What does Yunxi want to eat?

lines.speaker: teacher
lines.en: Today Yunxi is at home.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.pinyin: Yuè, nǐ lái wǒ jiā ba!
lines.en: Yue, come over to my place!

lines.speaker: yueB
lines.en: OK. Where is your home?

lines.speaker: hero
lines.en: My home is in the university.

lines.speaker: teacher
lines.pinyin: Yuè dào le. Yúnxī de jiā hěn xiǎo.
lines.en: Yue arrives. Yunxi's home is small.

lines.speaker: yueB
lines.hanzi: 你家真小！你一个人住吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ jiā zhēn xiǎo! Nǐ yí gè rén zhù ma?
lines.en: Your home is really small! Do you live alone?

lines.speaker: hero
lines.hanzi: 对，我一个人住。你想喝水吗？
lines.pinyin: Duì, wǒ yí gè rén zhù. Nǐ xiǎng hē shuǐ ma?
lines.en: Yes, I live alone. Would you like some water?

lines.speaker: yueB
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, xièxie. Nǐ zài zuò shénme?
lines.en: Yes, thanks. What are you doing?

lines.speaker: hero
lines.en: I'm listening to Chinese.

lines.speaker: yueB
lines.en: I want to listen too.

questions.qEn: What does Yue want to drink?

lines.speaker: teacher
lines.hanzi: 今天很热。云希和月去买东西。
lines.pinyin: Jīntiān hěn rè. Yúnxī hé Yuè qù mǎi dōngxi.
lines.en: It's hot today. Yunxi and Yue go shopping.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.en: Yue, what do you want to buy?

lines.speaker: yueB
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì běn shū.
lines.en: I want to buy a book.

lines.speaker: teacher
lines.en: There are lots of books there.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.en: How much is this book?

lines.speaker: teacher
lines.en: Thirty kuai.

lines.speaker: yueB
lines.pinyin: Sānshí kuài? Wǒ méiyǒu qián le.
lines.en: Thirty kuai? I'm out of money.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu! Wǒ gěi nǐ mǎi.
lines.en: I have some! I'll buy it for you.

lines.speaker: yueB
lines.hanzi: 谢谢你。你真是我的好朋友。
lines.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ. Nǐ zhēn shì wǒ de hǎo péngyou.
lines.en: Thank you. You really are my good friend.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.en: Let's go have tea!

questions.qEn: What does Yue want to buy?
